en: Berries are my favourite thing in the world. I like to share them! Here, have one.
Plant it somewhere and see what grows. Come back tomorrow for another!
Isn't it fun, thinking about all the different berries there are?
All my Pokémon ever does is roar. Roar, roar, roar! I've had quite enough of it. You take this.
Roar sends a wild Pokémon running, and in a battle with a trainer, it makes them switch.
